title: A section defining an affine principal open kills positive cohomology after a power
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme], let L be an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let s be a global section of L such that the principal open X_s [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] is affine. For every quasi-coherent O_X-module F [pqf-def-coherent], every p > 0, and every class xi in H^p(X,F) [pqf-def-cohomology], there is e >= 0 such that the map H^p(X,F) \to H^p(X,F tensor L^{tensor e}) induced by F \to F tensor L^{tensor e}, f \mapsto f tensor s^e, sends xi to zero; L^{tensor e} and s^e are the tensor power and induced section of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01XR (coherent-lemma-section-affine-open-kills-classes), using Lemma 09MR

proof.text: Apply the localization isomorphism of [lem-sc-invert-s-cohomology] to p, F, L, and s. Since X_s is affine and the restriction of a quasi-coherent module to an open subscheme is quasi-coherent, [pqf-lem-affine-vanishing] gives H^p(X_s,F restricted to X_s)=0 for p>0. Therefore the image of xi in the localized graded cohomology module is zero.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01XR proof, first paragraph, using Lemmas 09MR and 01XB

proof.text: By the definition of localization of a module, the vanishing of the image of the homogeneous class xi/1 means that some power s^e annihilates xi. In degree e this says exactly that the map H^p(X,F) to H^p(X,F tensor L^{tensor e}) induced by f maps f to f tensor s^e and sends xi to zero.
